drhp.business: The Company operates primarily in residential real estate development, offering premium and luxury apartments, villas, and plotted developments in major Indian cities including Mumbai, Gurugram, Pune, and Bengaluru. It also holds a Pulp and Paper business (Century Pulp and Paper) which is in the process of being sold to ITC Limited as a going concern on a slump sale basis, allowing the Company to concentrate on its core real estate growth opportunities.

drhp.expansion: The Pulp and Paper division undertook several technical upgradation and production enhancement initiatives. In the Paper Plant, a new unwind stand and vibrating screen were commissioned at PM1&2 to boost CHM sheeter capacity and quality. At PM3, an energy-efficient motor was installed in the hydra pulper. PM4 saw the installation of a ropeless tail feeding system and a CD caliper profile control system to improve reel building, increase moisture content, and reduce fibre consumption; the MMD drive system and AC01 controller were also upgraded.
